entity.name: Adib Mohsin
entity.description: Adib Mohsin is the founder and maintainer of Atlas, source control for AI coding agents, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He was an early core contributor to Headroom (70k+ stars), where he built the Go and TypeScript SDKs and wrote the docs, and he wrote USearch's Zig binding.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.description: Atlas is source control for AI coding agents. When several people on a team run coding agents on one codebase, git shows the diff but not whose agent made it or what it was asked to do. Atlas tracks which teammate's coding agent changed what and links commits to the sessions and prompts behind them. Teammates collaborate in real time in a shared workspace (not an IDE). The shared timeline is fully open source. A CLI plugs into a team's existing workspace in about 3 minutes, because we learned teams won't switch their stack. Atlas has 9k+ GitHub stars, 500+ weekly active users and 4B+ tokens processed, and it is free to use. Docs: https://docs.tryatlas.cc
